name: Storyboard Specification
purpose: JSON Schema for projects/<slug>/storyboard.json: scenes with timing, purpose, on-screen text, visual description, per-format layout notes, catalogue capabilities, beats, audio cues and an explicit transition out (type, capability, duration, continuity).
capabilities: Stage 1 scene plan that validation checks for gaps, reading-time floors and capability status
approval_evidence: Validated against projects/masala-chai-recipe/storyboard.json and the template storyboards (2026-10-30).
